title: Adaptive-Policy Distillation: Knowledge Injection under Information Asymmetry
abstract: arXiv:2611.00852v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD), which uses reverse-KL supervision on student rollouts to transfer a context-conditioned model's behavior into student model parameters for closed-book inference, has shown strong results. However, we find that this success does not translate to knowledge injection: across two document-QA benchmarks, OPD injects document knowledge far less efficiently than simple off-policy distillation. We trace this reversal to two failures that are structural, yet sparse across token positions. Reverse KL weights its gradient by the student distribution and therefore barely lifts document-specific tokens the student considers unlikely; after forward KL restores this signal, student rollouts expose later positions on the target trajectory only after generating the preceding tokens correctly, so coverage deteriorates with target length. translated_title: 自适应策略蒸馏：信息不对称下的知识注入
translated_abstract: 在-policy蒸馏（OPD）通过对学生模型的 rollout 施加反向 KL 监督，将上下文条件模型的行为迁移到学生模型参数中以实现闭卷推理，已展现出显著效果。然而，我们发现这种成功并不能延伸到知识注入任务：在两个文档问答基准上，OPD 注入文档知识的效率远低于简单的 off-policy 蒸馏。我们将这一逆转归因于两个结构性但仅在稀疏 token 位置上出现的失效：反向 KL 依据学生分布对梯度进行加权，因此几乎无法提升那些学生认为不太可能出现的文档特定 token；而当前向 KL 恢复了这一信号后，学生 rollout 只有在正确生成前序 token 之后才会暴露目标轨迹上的后续位置，导致覆盖率随目标长度增加而恶化。受教师与学生分歧集中于这些困难位置的启发，我们……
tldr: 该论文发现反向 KL 监督的在-policy蒸馏因梯度加权和 rollout 覆盖率问题在知识注入任务上反而失效，并提出自适应策略蒸馏，将监督集中分配到师生分歧最大的困难 token 位置上，从而实现高效的知识注入。
